llm.summary: The skill's requested resources and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (querying 0xArchive market data) and nothing in the SKILL.md attempts to access unrelated credentials, files, or system resources.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim to query historical and real-time market data from 0xArchive; the skill only requires a single API key (OXARCHIVE_API_KEY) and documents curl endpoints for the described exchanges and data types — this is proportionate and expected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is an instruction-only skill that tells the agent to call 0xArchive HTTP endpoints via curl, to read the API key from $OXARCHIVE_API_KEY, and to compute timestamps with date; it does not instruct reading unrelated files, system secrets, or sending data to third-party endpoints outside the documented API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or package downloads are present (instruction-only), so nothing will be written to disk or pulled from external sources during install — lowest-risk pattern for this kind of integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable is required (OXARCHIVE_API_KEY) and it is the documented auth mechanism for the API; there are no unrelated secrets or multiple credential requests that would be disproportionate to the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and has no install-time persistence; it is user-invocable and allows autonomous invocation by default (platform normal), but it does not request elevated or permanent system presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally coherent for calling the 0xArchive HTTP API and only needs an API key. Before installing: verify the 0xArchive service and provider (the skill's source/homepage is unknown in the registry metadata), ensure the API key you supply has minimal scope and can be rotated, never paste the key in public chat, and prefer creating a dedicated read-only key if the provider supports it. Because this is an instruction-only skill that will run curl commands, only grant the API key if you trust the API operator; monitor usage and rotate the key if you see unexpected requests.
